    @pytest.mark.xdist_group(name="group3")
    @allure.title("Complete running deal")
    def test_complete_running_deal(self, page: Page, create_session):
        deal_details_page = DealDetailsPage(page)
        login_page = LoginPage(page)
        notifications = Notifications(page)
        deals_api = DealsApi()
        danger_zone = DangerZone(page)
        toast_message = "Deal will be completed as soon as possible"
    
        with allure.step("Test preparation"):
            running_deals = deals_api.get_poloniex_running_deals()
            total_deals = running_deals['total']
            deal_id = None
    
            if total_deals == 0:
                pytest.skip("There are no deals in Running status")
    
            for deal in running_deals['items']:
                if deal['actions']['complete']:
                    deal_id = deal['id']
                    break
    
            if deal_id is None:
                pytest.skip("There are no deals with 'complete' action available")
    
            login_page.goto()
            create_session()
    
        with allure.step(f"Go to deals details page with id: {deal_id}"):
            deal_details_page.goto(endpoint=deal_details_page.slug.format(deal_id))
    
        with allure.step("Force complete deal"):
            danger_zone.click_danger_zone()
            danger_zone.click_complete_deal_btn()
            danger_zone.click_confirm_complete_deal_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Verify deal complete"):
            assert notifications.wait_for_success_toast() is True
            assert notifications.get_success_toast_message() == toast_message
